Bug_Title: InputSteam.read() implementation should not return a signed byte
Bug_Explanation: The read() method in BuggyInputStream returns a signed byte without converting it to an unsigned byte by applying a bitmask. This can lead to incorrect values when the byte value is outside the range of -128 to 127.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug in the BuggyInputStream class where the read() method returns a signed byte instead of an unsigned byte. This causes the assertEquals method to fail, as it compares the expected value (255) with the actual value returned by the showBug() method.
